deviations.what: record_decision keeps read-then-insert; the plan's 'inserts and reads only on duplicate key' is dropped
deviations.reason: a duplicate key inside a MongoDB transaction aborts it and the follow-up get raises NoSuchTransaction (verified on the Mongo rig by t27); nothing calls record_decision today; operator approved reverting the hunk

deviations.what: the default fire-rate cap (60 per trailing hour) does not apply to schedule triggers; event and probe rules keep it unless max_fires_per_hour is set
deviations.reason: a '* * * * *' schedule rule can be capped by evaluation clock jitter; cron already bounds a schedule rule's cadence; operator approved exempting schedule triggers

deviations.what: the trigger picker offers app actors (with declared events) as event surfaces, not machines; machine signals are reached through probe triggers (runner actor command on that machine)
deviations.reason: the Machine model declares no events, so a machine cannot be an event surface without a model change; probe triggers already cover machine-side signals
